name: bootloader-worker
description: Unified Cloudflare Worker for bootloader.art - thumbnails, sandbox sessions, IPFS proxy, and frontend

scripts.build:frontend:mainnet: cd ../apps/web && VITE_MEDIA_CDN_URL=https://media.bootloader.art VITE_SANDBOX_WORKER_URL=https://media.bootloader.art npm run build && rm -rf ../../worker/public && cp -r dist ../../worker/public
scripts.build:frontend:shadownet: cd ../apps/web && VITE_MEDIA_CDN_URL=https://media.shadownet.bootloader.art VITE_SANDBOX_WORKER_URL=https://media.shadownet.bootloader.art npm run build:shadownet && rm -rf ../../worker/public && cp -r dist ../../worker/public
scripts.deploy:mainnet: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && wrangler deploy --env production
